title: Church Gathering
definition: Church Gathering is the regular assembling of believers for worship, Scripture, fellowship, prayer, ordinances, encouragement, and mutual care.
summary: Church Gathering focuses on the regular assembling of believers to worship God, hear the Word, encourage one another, and practice visible fellowship.
christFocus: Jesus Christ meets with, strengthens, and shepherds His gathered people by His Word and Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church gathering is the regular assembling of believers for worship, Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and mutual encouragement. Scripture does not treat gathering as a religious add-on but as part of faithful Christian life.

The gathered church reminds believers that they belong to Christ and to one another. In a world of isolation, the assembly becomes a place where truth is heard, burdens are carried, and faith is strengthened.

Jesus is present with His people and is the One they gather to worship. The church does not gather around personalities, preferences, or programs, but around the risen Lord and His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many view church gathering as optional content consumption. This doctrine corrects that by showing gathering as covenant life, spiritual strengthening, and obedience, especially for people who are lonely, weary, or drifting.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Prioritize gathering with God's people as you are able, not to check a box but to worship Christ and strengthen the body. Come prepared to receive, serve, encourage, and be shaped by the Word.
